transcribed_question: Identify the area indicated by the pin. A. ... B. ...

marker.description: A pin with a white flag is inserted into the superior aspect of the brain, likely indicating the longitudinal fissure or a specific gyrus.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is inserted into the deep midline groove that separates the two cerebral hemispheres, which is the longitudinal fissure.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located within the longitudinal fissure?
supporting_question.explanation: The falx cerebri is a sickle-shaped fold of the dura mater that descends vertically in the median plane between the two cerebral hemispheres, occupying the longitudinal fissure.
